chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 53: Doctor Mo’s Forbidden Ritual Restores His Youth
chapter_meta_description: Doctor Mo forces his own blood to feed seven ghost blades in a forbidden ritual, emerging as a devastatingly handsome young man. Han Li watches in shock, trapped and calculating.
og_description: Doctor Mo’s forbidden ritual restores his youth—and Han Li sees a power beyond mortal understanding.
twitter_title: Doctor Mo goes from ancient to handsome in one ritual
twitter_description: Seven ghost blades, seven offerings of blood, and a terrifying young face. Chapter 53 of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality.
